message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). | Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. The winner of the round gets points equal to the total value of all cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each + 8 Wild cards (4 Wild, 4 Wild Draw 4). | 2 copies of each number 0–9 per color; 2 copies of each action card (Skip, Reverse, Draw 2) per color; 4 Wild and 4 Wild Draw 4. | | **Setup** | Shuffle the deck. Deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile. Turn the top card face‑up to start the discard pile. | If the first card is an action card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a Skip, the first player loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit around the table. The first player is the one to the left of the dealer. | The direction of play can change with Reverse cards. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches either the color, the number, or the symbol of the top discard. | If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes direction of play.
• **Draw 2** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw 4** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. | Wild Draw 4 can only be played if you have no other playable card of the current color. If you’re challenged and found to have a playable card, you must draw 4 cards plus the penalty. | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. | If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. | That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by opponents: numbers = face value, action cards = 20, Wild/Wild Draw 4 = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach 500 points (or the agreed target) wins. | If you’re playing a single round, the winner of that round is the overall winner. | --- ### Quick Play Tips 1. **Keep a mix of colors** – Having a variety of colors reduces the chance you’ll be stuck. 2. **Save Wild Draw 4** – Use it when you’re sure you have no matching color; it can swing the game. 3. **Watch the discard pile** – If someone plays a Skip or Reverse, anticipate the change in direction. 4. **UNO strategy** – Try to keep your hand balanced; avoid ending up with many high‑value cards. Enjoy your game!
